verdict.rationale: Casium is a business-immigration SaaS platform with a client portal, so offering a public API reference is a plausible capability and the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no API, developer docs, or runnable examples. Probes found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec at any candidate path (all 404), and no llms.txt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
